title: Vertical spring oscillation

source.credit: Rendered by Ansatz with exactly known physics (ω₀ = 11.18 rad/s, damping 0.35 /s)

slow_motion.evidence: No narration, captions or on-screen text indicate slow motion; animation appears continuous in real time.

subjects.description: small green rectangular mass hanging from the bottom of a vertical coil spring

observation.what_happens: A small green block hangs from a vertical coil spring and bobs up and down above a striped scale bar. The oscillation is already underway at the start of the clip and continues to the end with no release or catch visible.

calibration.note: no scale: lengths are in pixels

reasoning: The s data is a ~0.58 s period near-sine along a straight line with peaks slowly falling and valleys rising, so a vertical spring-mass oscillator with light damping. Candidates go from textbook undamped SHM to viscous damping to viscous plus quadratic air drag and cubic spring nonlinearity to test decay shape and amplitude-dependent period on the held-back frames.

caveats: Tracked in pixels with no physical scale, so spring results are in image units.
Clip shows ongoing bobbing with no visible release, so the start is inferred.
Leftover wobble is subpixel and close to tracking noise.
critique.finding: The green block keeps bouncing around {s_eq} while gentle friction {gamma} slowly shrinks each swing. It keeps a steady rhythm as it settles.
critique.headline: Spring block bobs and slowly settles downward
critique.why_it_won: It captures the smooth steady fade with simple friction, while extra square drag adds nothing useful.

headline: Spring block bobs and slowly settles downward
finding: The green block keeps bouncing around 95.3 ± 0.034 pix while gentle friction 0.35 ± 0.0014 1/s slowly shrinks each swing. It keeps a steady rhythm as it settles.

eyeball.confidence: low - only static frame visible, no oscillation period or decay observable, using typical animation values
eyeball.law_in_words: vertical mass on spring undergoes damped harmonic motion about equilibrium: x-double-dot + gamma*x-dot + omega0^2*(x - x_eq) = 0
